ic_name: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (Display Serial Interface, MIPI Alliance)

key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.ECC_parity_bits_p6_p7: Reserved, transmit as 0, receiver forces to 0 before processing.
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.ECC_parity_table_note: Full 24-row table is in DSI Spec §9.3 Table 22 (ECC Parity Generation Rules). The 64-entry syndrome decoder is in §9.3 Table 21 (ECC Syndrome Association Matrix).
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.CRC_covers: Long Packet payload bytes only (NOT header).
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.header_byte_order: DI (byte 0), WC[7:0] (byte 1), WC[15:8] (byte 2), ECC (byte 3); LSB-first on the wire within byte; little-endian byte ordering over the wire.
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.checksum_byte_order: CRC[7:0] (CRC LS Byte) first, then CRC[15:8] (CRC MS Byte); LSB-first on the wire within byte.
key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.multilane_byte_interleave_rule: byte k → lane (k mod N_data_lanes); byte 0 → Lane 0, byte 1 → Lane 1, ...

named_timing_parameters_D_PHY.T_HS_PREPARE_ns: 40 + 4 × UI .. 85 + 6 × UI — HS driver prepare time
named_timing_parameters_D_PHY.T_HS_ZERO_ns_min: 105 + 6 × UI — HS-0 state minimum before Sync
named_timing_parameters_D_PHY.T_CLK_PRE_ns_min: 8 × UI — Clock Lane HS active before Data Lane HS
named_timing_parameters_D_PHY.T_CLK_POST_ns_min: 60 + 52 × UI — Clock Lane HS active after last Data-Lane bit

default_signal_values_when_idle.Clock_Lane: LP-11 (Dp=1, Dn=1) if Non-Continuous Clock Mode; HS-0 if Continuous Clock Mode.

eotp_short_packet_constants.applicability: All HS transmissions when EoTp enabled; SHOULD NOT be sent for LP transmissions.

te_trigger_byte.purpose: Tearing Effect — Command Mode peripheral signals safe-to-write to host via LP Escape Mode trigger after BTA.

acknowledge_trigger_message_byte.purpose: Acknowledge — peripheral confirms reception of a non-Read host transmission with no errors stored.

named_timers.name: T_INIT_MASTER
named_timers.description: Host minimum LP-11 TX-Stop drive at power-on; must be ≥ t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY.

named_timers.name: T_INIT_SLAVE
named_timers.description: Peripheral minimum LP-11 RX-Stop monitor at power-on; R-C timer ±30% acceptable.

named_timers.name: HRX_TO
named_timers.description: HS RX Timeout — required in bidirectional peripheral.

named_timers.name: HTX_TO
named_timers.description: HS TX Timeout — required in host.

named_timers.name: LTX-P_TO
named_timers.description: LP TX-Peripheral Timeout — required in bidirectional peripheral.

named_timers.name: LRX-H_TO
named_timers.description: LP RX-Host Timeout — required in host; must be longer than LTX-P_TO.
